preamble: -- Preamble: lean/Verified.lean Parts A to H plus the Part I definitions (reachSet, AttachedTo, Gsum, Rsum), without the Part I lemmas.

targets.name: reach_sub
targets.about: reachSet is a subset of T
targets.statement: theorem reach_sub {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q : V) : reachSet R T q ⊆ T
targets.proof:
theorem reach_sub {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q : V) : reachSet R T q ⊆ T := by
  simp [reachSet]

targets.name: mem_reach
targets.statement: theorem mem_reach {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q x : V) : x ∈ reachSet R T q ↔ x ∈ T ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (stepIn R T) q x
targets.proof:
theorem mem_reach {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q x : V) : x ∈ reachSet R T q ↔ x ∈ T ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen (stepIn R T) q x := by
  simp [reachSet]

targets.name: reach_closed
targets.about: reachSet is closed under steps in T
targets.statement: theorem reach_closed {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q b c : V) (hb : b ∈ reachSet R T q) (hbc : stepIn R T b c) : c ∈ reachSet R T q
targets.stuck_goal:
V : Type
inst✝² : Fintype V
inst✝¹ : DecidableEq V
R : V → V → Prop
inst✝ : DecidableRel R
T : Finset V
q b c : V
hb : b ∈ reachSet R T q
hbc : stepIn R T b c
⊢ c ∈ reachSet R T q

targets.name: reach_empty
targets.about: nothing is reachable from a seed outside T
targets.statement: theorem reach_empty {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q : V) (hq : q ∉ T) : reachSet R T q = ∅
targets.stuck_goal:
V : Type
inst✝² : Fintype V
inst✝¹ : DecidableEq V
R : V → V → Prop
inst✝ : DecidableRel R
T : Finset V

hq : q ∉ T
⊢ reachSet R T q = ∅

targets.name: reach_rooted
targets.about: the piece reachable from q is connected and rooted at q
targets.statement: theorem reach_rooted {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) (q : V) (hq : q ∈ T) : RootedConn R (reachSet R T q) q
targets.stuck_goal:
V : Type
inst✝² : Fintype V
inst✝¹ : DecidableEq V
R : V → V → Prop
inst✝ : DecidableRel R

targets.name: attachedTo_empty
targets.about: with no seeds, only the empty set is attached
targets.statement: theorem attachedTo_empty {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) : AttachedTo R ∅ T ↔ T = ∅
targets.proof:
theorem attachedTo_empty {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (T : Finset V) : AttachedTo R ∅ T ↔ T = ∅ := by
  simp [AttachedTo]
  grind

targets.name: rest_attached
targets.about: removing q's piece leaves a set attached to the other seeds
targets.statement: theorem rest_attached {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (Q T : Finset V) (q : V) (h : AttachedTo R (insert q Q) T) : AttachedTo R Q (T \ reachSet R T q)
targets.stuck_goal:

inst✝¹ : DecidableEq V

inst✝ : DecidableRel R
Q T : Finset V
q : V
h : AttachedTo R (insert q Q) T
⊢ AttachedTo R Q (T \ reachSet R T q)

targets.name: Gsum_insert
targets.about: inductive step: peel off one seed's piece
targets.statement: theorem Gsum_insert {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (Q : Finset V) (q : V) : Gsum R τ (insert q Q) ≤ (1 + Rsum R τ q) * Gsum R τ Q
targets.stuck_goal:

⊢ Gsum R τ (insert q Q) ≤ (1 + Rsum R τ q) * Gsum R τ Q

targets.name: Gsum_le_prod
targets.statement: theorem Gsum_le_prod {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (R : V → V → Prop) [DecidableRel R] (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (Q : Finset V) : Gsum R τ Q ≤ ∏ q ∈ Q, (1 + Rsum R τ q)
